finding: A late document-picker callback used mutable intendedWorkspace state. Opening a newer picker could let an older result borrow the newer request ownership.
verificationOfFinding: Source/lifecycle audit; no wrong-account restore was performed and no real provider race was induced.
change: Both independently owned apps bind selection, cancellation and dismissal to immutable request ID and workspace generation. Stale/duplicate events are ignored; selected files are delivered once after dismissal, including dismissal-before-selection. Navigation invalidates the picker. The coordinated read receives the original generation explicitly.
dataContracts: No persistent schema, backup format, backend or Todoist source changes.

cases: stale selection/dismissal/cancellation after new workspace picker
stale callback after newer picker in same workspace
same account returns with a new generation
new picker does not inherit old undelivered file

nativeIOS.scope: Actual Files selection; controlled coordinated-read failure/wait; reachable Cancel and Retry preview; navigation/local workspace exit/return; unchanged full snapshot in failure/navigation cases and normal relaunch.

nativeIOS.setupNote: Supplemental real-team signing did not run: the certificate-display-name lookup incorrectly assumed the team ID appeared there. Native tests ran with the Xcode-built Simulator signatures. No signing change was made while tests ran.
